newsitem.title: UK: Converted building socs go into FTSE banks sector.
newsitem.headline: Converted building socs go into FTSE banks sector.

text.p: The FTSE Actuaries UK Indices Committee has decided not to create a special sector classification for converting building societies, a spokesman told Reuters on Thursday.

This means the Halifax Building Society, Woolwich Building Society, Alliance & Leicester Building Society and the Northern Rock Building Society will all join the "Banks" sector when they are floated later this year.

The spokesman said the matter had been discussed but it had been decided not to create a special sector which, arguably, could also have included former building society Abbey National Plc, which is currently listed among the banks.
The spokesman said difficulties of definition had been a major factor in rejecting the idea to create a seperate classification.
"These companies are converging not diverging," the spokesman added.

Some City analysts had expected a new sector to be formed saying that the former building societies are different enough in their business and balance sheet make-up to justify this. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
